decisions.statement: A page type is a page of any type reaching `page-type` by extending.
The walk out from `page-type` repeats until no type joins.
The walk finds a type only after finding every type that type extends.
A caller naming no types reads `page-type` alone.
Nothing here reads the properties a page type declares.
The types gathered from one reading are gathered once for that reading and held.

definition: which pages stand as page types, read from the types those pages are
